question:
(i) Using Gauss’s law, obtain the expression for electric field due to an infinite plane sheet of charge.
(ii) If the surface charge density of an infinite plane sheet is $4.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{C}\,\text{m}^{-2}$, calculate the electric field near the sheet. Take $\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\,\text{C}^2\,\text{N}^{-1}\,\text{m}^{-2}$.

options.A:
(i) $E=\frac{\sigma}{2\varepsilon_0}$, obtained using a pillbox Gaussian surface
(ii) $E\approx2.26\times10^5\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
options.B:
(i) $E=\frac{\sigma}{\varepsilon_0}$, obtained using a spherical Gaussian surface
(ii) $E\approx4.52\times10^5\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
